tasks.label: Docker: Run All Tests
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint '' -e DATABASE_URI=sqlite:// -e USER_INPUT_DATABASE_URI=sqlite:// app python -m pytest tests/

tasks.label: Docker: Run Small Pipeline Test
tasks.command: docker compose run --rm --no-deps --entrypoint '' -e DATABASE_URI=sqlite:// -e USER_INPUT_DATABASE_URI=sqlite:// app python -m pytest tests/matching_pipeline/test_small_pipeline.py -v

tasks.label: Docker: Run Matching & Import (Existing Data)
tasks.command: SKIP_DATA_IMPORT=true docker compose up -d db redis app && docker exec stop_sync_osm_atlas_app python -m matching_and_import_db.database.importer

tasks.label: Docker: Run Full Data Pipeline (Download & Match & Import)
tasks.command: docker compose up -d db redis app && docker exec stop_sync_osm_atlas_app bash -c "python matching_and_import_db/downloader/get_atlas_data.py && python matching_and_import_db/downloader/get_osm_data.py && python -m matching_and_import_db.database.importer"

tasks.label: Docker: Run Flask DB Upgrade
tasks.command: docker compose up -d db redis app && docker exec -it stop_sync_osm_atlas_app flask db upgrade
